card.name: Punctuation before publisher in citations
card.fires_on: The colon or comma right after a place or organization name in a reference entry, just before the publisher name. Also the last word of a publisher name such as Free Encyclopedia.

modes.label: Colon after city
modes.description: A colon after the publication city, leading into the publisher.
modes.example: The Catholic Encyclopedia. Vol. 13. New York<<:>> Robert Appleton Company, 19

modes.label: Comma after organization
modes.description: A comma after an author body or publisher, leading into place or publisher details.
modes.example: Department of Primary Industries and Energy<<,>> Australian Government Publishing Service, Canberra.

modes.label: End of publisher name
modes.description: The closing word of a web publisher name in a citation.

card.writes: It seems to prepare publisher and place names, not medical wording like impairment or decreased.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a reference list where the publisher or place comes next.
